original_attempt_interpretation.unsigned_negative: Four synthetic public atom-map cases: one failed refusal and three passing controls. The cast-before-validation defect is unchanged by other in-progress composition edits. Later guards extend to twelve cases across all three axis kinds.
original_attempt_interpretation.composition_pilot: 18 pass/four failures before maxfail: three strict snapshot mismatches (object string-label dtype and zero-dimensional quantity magnitudes) plus an incorrect expected public exception class. No scientific value/unit loss was observed.
original_attempt_interpretation.composition_diagnostic: 104 pass/three representation-only snapshot failures; writes actual observations for inspection.
original_attempt_interpretation.composition_directed: 107 pass after explicitly observing the two schema-defined HDF normalizations. Later source adds empty-presence/root-refusal guards before integrated/final qualification.
original_attempt_interpretation.no_structures_fixture: Original #660 fixture created an empty Structures object. Corrected fixture explicitly removes it and asserts presence before each call. Original 1,111-case results remain valid for their actual four-branch coverage, not the claimed five. The runtime helper already covers five preflights by inspection. Archive/receipt corrections retain the original evidence.

acceptance: Reuse all four existing domain codecs; private root 0.6 adds typed mechanics and explicit root writer metadata without changing the public 0.5 defaults.
Resident reconstruction requires connected declared identity axes. Independent explicit permutations remain accessible; equal counts do not authorize attachment.

Absent domains stay absent. Present-empty mechanical reports/tables retain native markers. Explicitly empty entire mechanics/analysis layers remain readable independently and refuse resident assembly when their presence cannot round-trip.

Three actual complete/projected/nonpolar-H-merged preparations restore in new processes under another unit policy, preserve original assignments/producer/history/maps, reproduce selected PDBQT bytes and retain coordinate-edit interaction invalidation, with preparation/attribution backends unavailable.

Typed settings use explicit field/unit/dimension handshakes; existing structural string-label and shared QuantityRecord scalar storage normalizations are observed explicitly rather than treated as lost values.
The reusable atomic helper covers completed visibility, exception cleanup, existing files, dangling links, a two-writer race and unsupported-link refusal. It never publishes a partial-copy fallback.

Identity metadata does not allocate a billion-element index vector; mechanics preparation occurs once and geometry reuses bounded transfers. These are representation/control guards, not a massive-system benchmark.
Public unsigned maps reject out-of-range values before narrowing/output, while valid uint64 permutations and signed unknown entries survive across atom/structure/structure-state axes.
Clean source passes all 1,229 affected cases, fourteen fast gates and fresh HTML; three rendered pages are inspected and six baseline warnings retained.
limits: #256 remains open. Public version dispatch/conversion/query/selection/copy/append and migration are P4; client and final format/default-writer qualification remain P5/P6.
No complete external-engine state, completed force field, arbitrary metadata class, whole-format stability or H5MSM 1.0 publication is implied.
Unsupported independent-layer resident compositions refuse; no atom identity, chemistry or coordinates are synthesized from matching cardinalities.
Hard-link publication is atomic visibility on a supporting destination filesystem, not crash durability. Abrupt termination can leave a private staging file.
All source attempts, warning counts and raw hashes remain separate. No earlier failed run is relabeled passing.
The original audit weights remain unchanged. #661 closure is supplemental work only after verified public delivery.
